- [USER] User expressed interest in the Seiko 5 Sports and Fossil Grant.
- [USER] User asked for more information about their water resistance and maintenance requirements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided water resistance details:
  - Seiko 5 Sports: 100m (10ATM) suitable for swimming and snorkeling in shallow water.
  - Fossil Grant: 30m (3ATM) suitable for rain and brief immersion in water.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided maintenance requirements for both watches:
  - Seiko 5 Sports: Automatic movement, occasional cleaning, and service every 3-5 years.
  - Fossil Grant: Quartz movement, battery replacement every 1-2 years, and cleaning.
